dedupe_keys.name: livorno civil protection assembly shelter and monitored underpass locations

description: The Municipality of Livorno publishes locations used in its civil-protection plan approved in November 2011. The grouped components identify initial assembly areas, places for temporary tent accommodation, covered municipal buildings suitable for evacuees, and underpasses monitored during flooding. Assembly areas are described as equipped with water, electricity and first-aid supplies. Temporary accommodation distinguishes sports-field camps, smaller peripheral sites and two campgrounds. Covered shelters use buildings such as sports halls and gyms that have other ordinary functions. The source-defined plan is retained as an overlapping parent; the separately catalogued flood-prone-road layer remains a related resource. Native metadata explains site-selection considerations including accessibility, sanitary services, public ownership, nearby population and hazards. Some assembly sites retain coastal or river-flood exposure. The assembly-area lineage reports 25 areas, but its geographic breakdown sums to 26; that count conflict is unresolved. These are historical designated locations and planning assumptions, not verified present capacities or a guarantee of safety. They provide explicit emergency-response planning information. Native records state CC BY 4.0 and list geographic formats. No map, feature, plan file or facility record was opened; present operation and data accuracy remain unverified.
